caseNameFull: Metlakatla Indian Community, Annette Island Reserve v. Egan, Governor of Alaska and Organized Village of Kake v. Egan, Governor of Alaska
attorneys: Solicitor General Rankin on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeals from the District Court for Alaska. The motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, is granted and one-half hour is allowed for that purpose.
